exposure: Incidental appendectomy at time of exploratory laparotomy
outcome: Upstaging due to metastasis to the appendix
cohort: The study included 513 patients undergoing exploratory laparotomy with the gynecologic oncology division, excluding those with cesarean hysterectomy and reoperation.
finding: Incidental appendectomy at the time of gynecologic oncology laparotomy was safe, did not increase the risk of complications or length of hospital stay, and revealed a high rate of occult abnormal histology even with a normal intraoperative appearance.
